question: What is the main difference between 802.11 and Ethernet? [IEEE 802.11]
options: Ethernet uses a distributed access scheme, while 802.11 uses a centralized controller
802.11 uses collision avoidance (CSMA/CA), while Ethernet uses collision detection (CSMA/CD)
Ethernet is wireless, while 802.11 is wired
802.11 has a higher transmission speed than Ethernet
Ethernet operates at higher frequencies than 802.11
correct_answer: 802.11 uses collision avoidance (CSMA/CA), while Ethernet uses collision detection (CSMA/CD)
